pages.title: Nutrition HUD
pages.text: Nourished adds a compact HUD overlay showing all six nutrient bars in real time — no need to open the Diet Screen.$(br2)$(bold)Customizing the HUD:$()$(br2)Press $(k:nourished.hud_edit) to enter edit mode. From there you can:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Drag$() the overlay to any screen position$(li)$(thing)Resize$() it to fit your layout$(br2)$(italic)Set it once and forget it exists — until you need it.$()
